title: Shoot the Moon — The Claim

tracks.description: Orbital machinery; finite gestures leave transmission, vacuum and breath space.
Wide lunar air; follows the full arc, ending naturally at the reel boundary.
Sparse 49 Hz punctuation, alternating with kick rather than doubling every pulse.
Mechanical kick and industrial snare; asymmetrical propulsion and double-time raid.
Steel landmarks and high machine ticks; recurring 3+3+2 cell.
Low-boom phrase weight reserved for touchdown, strikes, and claim.
First Strike broadband mass; reduced counterstrike and scar callbacks.
Four-second pressure gestures positioned by their actual endpoints.
Two-second steel suction connects launch, impacts and final resolution.
D/Ab gated alarm: reversal warning, then alien 3+3+2 attack identity.
Human/Claim D-A-E-F: restrained open fifth, questioning ninth, determined minor third; expanded F-sharp at resolution.
Rival Eb-D-A-Ab semitone collapse; inversion/reordering at reversal, high tritone raid coloration.
Sparse suspended D-minor field becomes Bb(add9), Gsus, then D(add9) claimed-Moon resolution.
Pitched eighth-note machinery moves D/C/Bb/A; no sustained sub blanket.

description: FINAL / one revision. Locked Shoot the Moon score: 100 BPM, 4/4, 24 bars / 57.6s at 60fps. D-A-E-F Human/Claim; Eb-D-A-Ab Vesper, reversed at counterstrike; D/Ab Divider 3+3+2 double-time. True vacuum 21.0–21.6. Broader Bb(add9)-Gsus-Asus-D(add9) resolution. Reduced breath tails, stronger rival/midrange, controlled transients. Native renderer retains post-reel release padding.
